q: 默认 Card Game 规则里，哪些描述是正确的？
options: 同点数不同花色的牌不能被同一个三元组选中
标准局 36 张牌，点数 1-9，每个点数四种花色
牌摆在 3x4 网格里，合法移动清除三张点数和为 15 的牌
三张牌被清除后，引擎会从牌堆补牌填满空位
why: 默认小测试关注基础正确性；点数可以重复，因为不同花色代表不同实体牌，只要点数凑够就能同选——选项一正好把这条说反了。
why_en: The base game is a small refillable grid where triples are defined by values, and same-value cards from different suits are freely interchangeable, so option 1 has it backwards.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Deck[Deck] --> Grid[3x4 grid]
  Grid --> Pick[Pick 3 cards]
  Pick --> Sum{sum is 15}
  Sum -->|yes| Clear[Clear cards]
  Clear --> Refill[Refill from deck]
options_en: Two cards with the same value but different suits cannot be picked into the same triple.
The base game has 36 cards, values 1-9, four suits per value.
Cards sit in a 3x4 grid; a legal move clears three cards whose values sum to 15.
After three cards are cleared, the engine refills the empty slots from the deck.

q: 这条理论回合上限对 Solver 的设计目标意味着什么？
options: 评测门槛是均 32 回合，几乎每局都要接近上限，容错很小
只要不提前卡死就算达标，回合数本身不重要
上限只是理论值，测试对回合数没有具体门槛
补牌规则会让上限跟着提高，33 不是硬约束
why: 上限 33 与门槛 32 之间只差 1 回合，说明像 first-found 这种不评估后果的策略几乎注定不够；Solver 必须让绝大多数回合都选到不孤立牌的三元组。
why_en: With only one turn of slack between the 33-turn ceiling and the 32-turn bar, the solver must make a near-optimal choice on almost every turn, so a blind first-found strategy is not enough.
scenario: 优化测试用 100 张牌、每回合固定移除 3 张、且没有随机补牌；100 = 33×3 + 1，所以最多能走 33 个完整回合，最后必然剩 1 张打不出。
options_en: The bar is an average of 32 turns, so almost every game must get close to the ceiling — there is very little slack.
The solver only has to avoid getting stuck early; the exact turn count doesn't matter.
The ceiling is just a theoretical value; the real test sets no concrete turn-count bar.
The refill rule would raise the ceiling, so 33 isn't really a hard constraint.
